name: Mukouda Yoiko
source: A childhood friend of the Hase siblings who lives close to [url=/c5401]Hiroshi[/url]. She has a good relationship with her family, especially with her mother. She's worried about Hiroshi because he's spending too much time with the delinquents and tries to protect and take care of him however she can.
